caption: A tight close-up captures the glossy deep-red bodywork of a car, where a thin circular outline sits on the right half of a curved side panel. A dark horizontal band runs along the top edge, a black wheel-arch curve anchors the bottom-left, and a bright elongated specular highlight streaks diagonally across the lower-middle of the paint. Throughout, the view travels laterally along the surface, so the circular ring steadily drifts toward the right edge and passes out of view. As the camera moves, more of the left side of the panel is revealed, bringing a near-vertical panel seam into view at the left edge. Several small bright overhead-light reflections appear scattered along that newly exposed region. The long specular highlight shifts downward and slightly as the angle of the curved surface changes relative to the lens. The dark top band and the black wheel-arch curve remain roughly in place, indicating the framing change is dominated by horizontal travel rather than tilt. The lateral glide continues steadily, carrying the eye across the smooth red paint.
